scope: Independent read-only review of frozen current TX2026 six-poll supplied-state math. No model fit, historical replay, actual posterior, provider registration, forecast, publication, or improvement finding.

independentChecks.finding: Prototype only loads authenticated frozen consumer, review, manifest and six-poll bank; code has no sampler, optimizer, registry, forecast export, historical replay or result-label path. Source hashes and bank SHA independently matched author pins.

Code and tests sum normalized six-dimensional Gaussian component densities with one shared bank-row index. A separate two-dimensional SciPy calculation matched logdensity; product of marginal mixtures differed.

Mean gradient equals responsibility-weighted covariance solve with correct sign. Independent two-dimensional central difference maximum absolute error 1.2719936215432881e-11. The six same-pair rate-port means all equal log(3/2); author PyTensor finite-difference ladder and derivative-sum tests passed.

Each parent downstream kernel is normalized separately before multiplying the original mass. Independent 3/10,7/10 fixture returned exactly those marginals; author also tests unequal normalizers and eight equal parents.

Original 1/4000 calibration row weights are retained; conditional responsibilities are distinct from both input and integrated masses. Zero-weight rows, numerical and symbolic unsupported overflow, invalid vector axes, covariance SPD, and one-point incumbent reduction have focused tests.

The first run failed exact floating-bit weight equality. The author retained the failed attempt, removed unintended renormalization, added shape and unsupported-range guards across later preserved attempts, and final attempt5 passed without loosening frozen tolerances.

independentSyntheticProbe.tool: existing isolated Python/NumPy/SciPy environment; read-only in-memory fixture

limitations: Computational agreement at supplied means does not evaluate any protected-parent normalizer Z_j, integrate the full native posterior, establish native count-graph factor ownership, or qualify a forecast.

The current bank contains reviewed historical poll-error calibration data, but original source publication histories remain unverified; Oct20 source availability uses a field-end proxy. This test does not establish strict as-of availability or a leakage-free historical replay.

The numeric helper is pinned to the current six-poll bank and exact source bytes, while its consumer accepts later 2026 cutoff arguments. Treat the returned object as a numerical fixture only; an actual later edition requires separate source and time admission.

The count graph example is invented and the rate port is uninstalled. Matched earlier-only bank refits, calibration/downstream source dependence, full-cut validity, empirical skill and precision/practical adoption gates remain open.
decision: Supports only the declared CPU float64 supplied-state mathematical readiness result. No evidence for model promotion or public deployment.
